'''VibroSword Ten''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in [[VibroSword Squadron]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during [[Operation Roundabout]]. He flew an [[Eta-5 interceptor]] like his wingmates, and flew alongside [[Syal Antilles]] during the operation.
